chapter.title: Green School
chapter.tagline: Building eco-friendly schools through waste segregation, composting, herbal gardens, and resource conservation
chapter.overview: Walking to school together, Aasha and Mohit dream of making their school a true 'Green School'. With teachers and classmates, they launch waste segregation (green vs. blue bins), dig an organic compost pit, set up bird baths and herbal patches, and conduct simple energy audits.
